content:
tom: Heads-up0: Client Rainscape wants a 48h migration POC to validate compat with their current provider. Must match webhook shapes, callback retry headers, and token accounting. They also sent a security questionnaire today.

anya: I can stand up a compatibility proxy that rewrites our callback to their exact shape. Their payload expects top-level "events" array and a "delivery_id" header. Will preserve X-Request-Id and HMAC signature.

ryan: For parity checks: run 2k canonical prompts through both systems, collect token counts under both tokenizers, and compute semantic diffs (ROUGE/embedding-sim). Flag any >10% semantic variance. I can run this on a tiny Dedicated cluster. ETA 18h to prepare.

marcus: Product note: recommend pinning to model v2.1-compat for the POC; some families trim salutations differently which affects downstream parsers. Also call out our tokenizer will split some account identifiers differently.

hannah: Security asks: IP allowlist + mTLS for callbacks + completed questionnaire. They also want assurance logs are KMS-wrapped and that POC data won't be used for training. Need their SAML SP metadata if they want SSO.

legal: Rainscape requests a POC addendum with 30-day retention and no secondary use. We can add that. Who owns purge implementation and signature on the addendum?

anya: I'll add a POC tag to all persisted artifacts and implement a purge job that deletes after 30 days. Will draft a short runbook for legal.

ryan: Quick curl for smoke (replace KEY):

```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.dev/rainscape/generate -H "X-Client-Id: rainscape-poc" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"Summarize this monthly ledger...","max_tokens":200,"temperature":0}'
```

Proxy will buffer streaming and POST final JSON to their callback with preserved headers and signature.

marcus: Pricing Q they asked: will billing tokens be 1:1? Short answer: no. We'll produce a token multiplier table after the paired run. Offer a trial credit for the POC and reconcile once we measure.

hannah: Netops wants our egress CIDRs and SOC2 excerpt. Ops-bot: please post CIDRs.

ops-bot: egress CIDRs posted: 54.210.32.0/24, 3.120.45.0/24. SOC2 excerpt uploaded to shared drive as SOC2_excerpt_redwood.pdf.

legal: I'll draft the 30-day, non-use addendum and circulate for signature. Confirm who at Rainscape signs.

tom: Action items: @anya proxy + buffering + purge, @ryan run parity job, @hannah send security questionnaire link to rainscape/secops, @legal draft addendum. Rainscape contact: integration@rainscape.com.

anya: Deploying compat proxy branch rainscape/compat-demo now.

ops-bot: deploy started: branch=rainscape/compat-demo build=4214 ETA=6m :rocket:

tom: Goal: have POC live and first parity report within 48h. If SOC2 or firewall rules block, escalate to AE. :thumbsup:
